helpers.name: NewNative
helpers.what: wraps a handler address into a native function value; push handler; call; add esp,4

helpers.name: SetMember
helpers.what: sets a member on an object by name: push eax(native); push "Name"; mov ecx,object; call

helpers.name: GetArgInt
helpers.what: argument i of the script call as an int (push i; call)

helpers.name: GetArg
helpers.what: argument i of the script call as it is (push i; call); the value is then converted by the caller

helpers.name: NewResultObject
helpers.what: creates the result object of a native: push type; call (types seen 1, 2, 5, 9, 32)

helpers.name: ReturnUndefined
helpers.what: ends a native with no value

helpers.name: ReturnBool
helpers.what: ends a native with a bool

helpers.name: ReturnInt?
helpers.what: ends a native with a value (jmp 0x9DABC0)

helpers.name: ReturnValue?
helpers.what: ends a native with a value (jmp 0x9DACA0)

helpers.name: ReturnString
helpers.what: ends a native with a string: push char*; call

helpers.name: SetPropInt?
helpers.what: sets a property on the result object by name (int pointer)

helpers.name: SetProp?
helpers.what: sets a property on the result object by name

helpers.name: SetProp?
helpers.what: sets a property on the result object by name

helpers.name: SetPropString
helpers.what: sets a string property (formats into a stack buffer first)

helpers.name: FindScreen
helpers.what: screen object from a screen id, through the manager pointer at [0x12AA044]

helpers.name: PostGameEvent
helpers.what: posts a command to the game (the handlers that act, such as OnEnterComplete and the Cmd setters)

globals.name: ScreenManager*
globals.what: global pointer to the screen manager (FindScreen's this)
